_comment: The files copied (GENERATED, never hand-edited) into the backend repo by backend/scripts/sync-fourplayer.mjs, paths relative to src/logic. Every relative import of a listed file must resolve to another listed file, or the generator refuses to run — so client-only modules (setup, presentation, premove, annotations) can never leak into the server. Entries under fourPlayer/ are also re-exported, in this order, by the generated backend index.ts.
